acceptanceCriteria: Nested includes and cross-file overrides resolve in Ruby evaluation order (later definition wins, customization block after shared body) with fixtures for each; anything still ambiguous abstains; abstention-rate change measured on the V1-1877 suite.
body: Residual of V1-1866/V1-1867 review fixes (PR #1166 head 4aaef55de). To remove false INELIGIBLE verdicts, the reader now abstains (RB-HELPER-UNRESOLVED) when a helper's candidate definitions span files (customization-block override of a shared-file helper) or come through a nested include_context/include_examples inside a shared group. Correct but lossy: real suites often layer shared contexts.
title: RSpec helper resolution: resolve nested shared-context includes and cross-file customization overrides instead of abstaining
